notes.title: Patch 250519
notes.content:
It's been a while, but I finally was able to fix a few more bugs and get Russian localization to the point where it's no longer just a terrible machine-translated nonsense.

[list]
[*]Fixed crash bug when equipping one of the hats in [spoiler]SGOE mode[/spoiler]. Also fixed its placement in the item menu.
[*]Fixed the speed of blue slimes spawned at the first boss fight in [spoiler]hard mode[/spoiler].
[*]Fixed HP of right-facing enemy plants in [spoiler]hell mode[/spoiler].
[*][spoiler]Beetle[/spoiler] state pop-ups no longer get swallowed by the game.
[*]Added proper Russian localization.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 240920
notes.content:
The game is so full of secrets and hidden locations, lots of stuff slipped by in the original release. This patch should address most of these issues.

[list]
[*] Fixed progression block in the Well of Perfection, where the scanner refused to activate sometimes.
[*] Fixed crashes and several broken mechanics related to Well of Perfection.
[*] Fixed a crash when using Trick Box with Blind status.
[*] Fixed Toy Magician mechanics.
[*] Increased spike and certain enemy projectile damage x4 to compensate for increased grace period.
[*] Improved camera in the Sky Castle area.
[*] Fixed several broken mechanics of late-game bosses on the B-route.
[*] Fixed and added many sound effects.
[*] Lots and lots of other minor stuff.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Quality of Life Update #1!
notes.content:
Large portion of the game has been rewritten in a newer version of Game Maker in order to play nicer with modern systems and Steam APIs. Here's a short list of changes:

[list]
[*] Overhauled player controls, physics and animation. The platforming should feel more natural and responsive.
[*] All new options and pause menu.
[*] The game pauses during inventory menu.
[*] Steam API support - the game supports achievements, screenshots and Steam overlay.
[*] Steam Deck Compatibility!
[*] 10% Faster gameplay.
[*] Multiple language support. Sadly, only English works for now, but we hope to add other languages eventually.
[*] Lots and lots of minor tweaks and adjustments, new effects, sounds etc.
[/list]
